name: Hook Library
description: Opening lines and patterns that grab attention while staying on-brand.

question.description: Open with a question the audience cares about.
examples: What if you could ship twice as fast without hiring?
Why do most DevOps initiatives stall after year one?

statistic.description: Lead with a surprising or credible number.
examples: 40% of our users cut deployment time in the first month.
We ran 2M builds last quarter. Here's what we learned.

story.description: Start with a short, relatable scenario.
examples: Last Tuesday a customer asked us for a feature we'd never built. By Friday it was live.
Most people think you need a big team to move fast. We don't.

direct_value.description: State the benefit in the first line.
examples: You can now run our pipeline from the CLI in under 60 seconds.
